content.title: Facility Typography Variant | Choices Activate Wayfinding Surfaces
content.summary: Establish one clearly adult original traveler, stable identity anchors and one readable route direction. Require a visible choice or passage action before each short word activates on a physical facility. Register every word to a sign, gate, elevator, clock, route or building surface rather than floating overlay. Keep the same traveler and path continuous as facility scale and route information expand. Reach a destination surface that confirms the choice, then return to the same adult identity anchor.

quick_start.input_format: Establish one clearly adult original subject and a clockwork coordinate system before text moves. + Require one visible subject action before each exact word engages a mechanical duty. + Assign each word one distinct pendulum, gear, spring, rewind or loop behavior. + Escalate mechanical scale or disorder while preserving subject identity and the same coordinate system. + Return every mechanism to a readable zero state around the same adult identity anchor.
quick_start.recommended_input: At an original midnight coastal research terminal, establish one clearly adult Black woman in a rust coat carrying a silver instrument case; preserve her face, braids and forward route. She enters an elevator marked only 'LEVEL 4', crosses a corridor where the exact word 'LISTEN' is built into acoustic wall fins, and checks one round clock. The car reaches a cliff observatory whose doorway carries only 'BEGIN'; return to the same adult face reflected in the door glass and hold.

creative_dna.mechanism: Establish one clearly adult original traveler, stable identity anchors and one readable route direction. Require a visible choice or passage action before each short word activates on a physical facility. Register every word to a sign, gate, elevator, clock, route or building surface rather than floating overlay. Keep the same traveler and path continuous as facility scale and route information expand. Reach a destination surface that confirms the choice, then return to the same adult identity anchor. The reusable mechanism is the ordered baseline, trigger, continuity, controlled escalation and terminal proof—not the source identities, brands, wording, locations, props, exact styling, choreography, camera path, creator identity or timing.

invariants.rule: Establish one clearly adult original traveler, stable identity anchors and one readable route direction.
invariants.purpose: Makes the baseline measurable before the mechanism changes it.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without the baseline, later change has no trustworthy reference state.

invariants.rule: Require a visible choice or passage action before each short word activates on a physical facility.
invariants.purpose: Binds the first visible change to a specific cause rather than decoration.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without a visible trigger, the transition reads as an arbitrary edit.

invariants.rule: Register every word to a sign, gate, elevator, clock, route or building surface rather than floating overlay.
invariants.purpose: Preserves identity, material or spatial continuity through the middle transition.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without continuity, the sequence becomes unrelated montage or identity drift.

invariants.rule: Keep the same traveler and path continuous as facility scale and route information expand.
invariants.purpose: Raises intensity or information while retaining the same readable grammar.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without controlled escalation, the middle either plateaus or turns into noise.

invariants.rule: Reach a destination surface that confirms the choice, then return to the same adult identity anchor.
invariants.purpose: Provides a terminal proof that resolves the mechanism instead of merely stopping.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without terminal proof, the promised result or reversal remains unverified.

slots.name: lead_subject
slots.constraint: An original stable subject or pair with a readable role.

slots.name: setting
slots.constraint: A new setting with fixed spatial anchors and no source-specific surface.

slots.name: escalation_variable
slots.constraint: One causal variable that changes through visible stages.

slots.name: performance_rule
slots.constraint: A restrained acting or motion rule that keeps the mechanism legible.

slots.name: camera_grammar
slots.constraint: An information order that proves each state without copying source shot boundaries.

slots.name: payoff
slots.constraint: A clean final physical, informational or social consequence.

slots.name: sound_family
slots.constraint: An original hierarchy of diegetic cues; no unsupported source-audio claim.

anti_copy_exclusions: source anime woman, face, clothes and hairstyle
source Tokyo subway, gates, elevators, clocks, trains and city signs
source Japanese and English wording, route codes and fonts
source exact route, station geography, transitions and timing
source creator identity, MiniMax H3 claim, platform marks and thread wording
